prompt: Could you ___ me through the new software setup step by step?
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone through something означает «подробно объяснить кому-либо, как что-то сделать, провести по всем этапам».

prompt: Anyone who dismisses the climate data as a minor glitch is ___ complete nonsense.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении talk nonsense («нести чушь / говорить ерунду») используется глагол talk.

prompt: “Good morning, is that Dr. Patel?” — “Yes, ___. How may I assist you?”
explanation_ru: В телефонном разговоре для подтверждения своей личности («У аппарата / Я слушаю») используется слово Speaking.

prompt: During the coffee break, most of the investors stood by the window ___ shop instead of relaxing.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение talk shop (как и talk business) означает «говорить о работе / делах».

prompt: Before she left the company, our former manager always ___ down to the interns.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk down to someone означает «говорить с кем-либо свысока, снисходительно».

prompt: Nobody managed to ___ my brother out of cancelling his flight at the last minute.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone out of doing something означает «отговорить кого-либо от какого-то поступка».

prompt: Please don't ___ down to the new apprentices; they already have university degrees.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk down to someone переводится как «разговаривать с кем-либо свысока».

prompt: We ran into our old classmates outside the museum and stood near the fountain ___ for over an hour.
explanation_ru: Для описания неформальной дружеской беседы в течение какого-то времени используется глагол talk.

prompt: It goes without ___ that laboratory staff must wear protective goggles at all times.
explanation_ru: Идиома It goes without saying означает «само собой разумеется».

prompt: We only need a small catering order for the workshop: let's ___ twelve sandwiches.
explanation_ru: Вводное выражение let's say используется для приблизительной оценки или примера («скажем, двенадцать сэндвичей»).

prompt: To ___ the truth, I haven't had a chance to check your attachment yet.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении to tell the truth («по правде говоря») используется глагол tell.

prompt: Could I ___ to the reception desk, please? I'm calling from Room 215 about my key card.
explanation_ru: В вежливой официальной просьбе по телефону («Могу я поговорить с...») обычно используется глагол speak.

prompt: Will anyone talk out against the closure of the local youth centre?
answer: Will anyone speak out against the closure of the local youth centre?
accepted_answers: Will anyone speak out against the closure of the local youth centre?
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол speak out against означает «публично выступить против чего-либо»; глагол talk здесь не подходит.

prompt: It went without saying that passengers with delayed flights would receive meal vouchers.
answer: It went without saying that passengers with delayed flights would receive meal vouchers.
accepted_answers: It went without saying that passengers with delayed flights would receive meal vouchers.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: устойчивое выражение It went without saying («само собой разумелось») употреблено верно.

prompt: Professor Lin has been invited to say at the annual robotics symposium in Berlin.
answer: Professor Lin has been invited to speak at the annual robotics symposium in Berlin.
accepted_answers: Professor Lin has been invited to speak at the annual robotics symposium in Berlin.
Professor Lin has been invited to talk at the annual robotics symposium in Berlin.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения публичного выступления с докладом на конференции используется глагол speak (или talk), но не say.

prompt: The minister's refusal to comment yesterday told volumes about the crisis.
answer: The minister's refusal to comment yesterday spoke volumes about the crisis.
accepted_answers: The minister's refusal to comment yesterday spoke volumes about the crisis.
explanation_ru: Идиома speak volumes («говорить о многом / быть весьма красноречивым») требует глагола speak.

prompt: To tell the least, postponing the championship match ten minutes before kickoff was frustrating.
answer: To say the least, postponing the championship match ten minutes before kickoff was frustrating.
accepted_answers: To say the least, postponing the championship match ten minutes before kickoff was frustrating.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом вводном выражении to say the least («мягко говоря») используется глагол say.

prompt: You can't wear slippers to the town hall — the neighbours will say!
answer: You can't wear slippers to the town hall — the neighbours will talk!
accepted_answers: You can't wear slippers to the town hall — the neighbours will talk!
explanation_ru: В значении «люди начнут сплетничать / пойдут разговоры» используется непереходный глагол talk без дополнения.

prompt: Telling of laptops, have you backed up your files yet?
answer: Speaking of laptops, have you backed up your files yet?
accepted_answers: Speaking of laptops, have you backed up your files yet?
Talking of laptops, have you backed up your files yet?
explanation_ru: Вводный оборот для смены или развития темы «Кстати о...» строится с глаголами speaking или talking (Speaking of / Talking of).

prompt: Don't tell the students off before you hear their side of the story.
answer: Don't tell the students off before you hear their side of the story.
accepted_answers: Don't tell the students off before you hear their side of the story.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: фразовый глагол tell someone off («отругать кого-либо») употреблен правильно.

prompt: You are annoyed because your relatives always start discussing politics during holiday meals and end up arguing. Which sentence fits best?
options: Why do they always have to talk politics at family dinners when it only causes arguments?
Why do they always have to say politics at family dinners when it only causes arguments?
Why do they always have to tell politics at family dinners when it only causes arguments?
Why do they always have to speak politics at family dinners when it only causes arguments?
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание talk politics означает «обсуждать политику».

prompt: You want to give an honest opinion about a homemade sauce that needs more seasoning. Which sentence is natural?
options: To say you the truth, this sauce needs a bit more garlic.
To tell you the truth, this sauce needs a bit more garlic.
To speak you the truth, this sauce needs a bit more garlic.
To talk you the truth, this sauce needs a bit more garlic.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении to tell someone the truth («по правде говоря») всегда используется глагол tell.

prompt: A journalist reports that diplomats paused official negotiations for two weeks. Which sentence uses the right word?
options: After three days of meetings, the diplomats paused the trade says until next month.
After three days of meetings, the diplomats paused the trade tells until next month.
After three days of meetings, the diplomats paused the trade talks until next month.
After three days of meetings, the diplomats paused the trade speaks until next month.
explanation_ru: Существительное talks во множественном числе используется в значении «официальные переговоры» (trade talks, peace talks).

prompt: You are on a noisy street and cannot hear your friend clearly. What do you say?
options: Please say up; the construction noise is drowning out your voice.
Please tell up; the construction noise is drowning out your voice.
Please talk up; the construction noise is drowning out your voice.
Please speak up; the construction noise is drowning out your voice.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол speak up означает «говорить громче».

prompt: The concert is about to start and the hall suddenly becomes quiet. Which sentence describes this?
options: As soon as the conductor walked on stage, the audience stopped talking and listened.
As soon as the conductor walked on stage, the audience stopped saying and listened.
As soon as the conductor walked on stage, the audience stopped telling and listened.
As soon as the conductor walked on stage, the audience stopped speaking and listened.
explanation_ru: Для описания болтовни или разговоров зрителей между собой естественнее всего использовать глагол talk (stop talking).

prompt: You are joking that your portable charger is a lifesaver on long trips. Which phrase completes the thought naturally?
options: This power bank is my pocket generator, so to say.
This power bank is my pocket generator, so to speak.
This power bank is my pocket generator, so to tell.
This power bank is my pocket generator, so to talk.
explanation_ru: Устойчивый вводный оборот so to speak переводится как «так сказать».

prompt: Don't try to (say / talk) me into buying an extended warranty I don't need.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone into doing something означает «уговорить кого-либо сделать что-то».

prompt: The coach (spoke / told) us off yesterday for arriving late to practice.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол tell someone off означает «отчитать / отругать кого-либо».

prompt: To (say / tell) you the truth, I rarely get eight hours of sleep on weekdays.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении to tell someone the truth («честно говоря / по правде говоря») употребляется глагол tell.

prompt: (Saying / Speaking) of vacations, have you renewed your passport yet?
explanation_ru: Вводная фраза Speaking of... используется для перехода к связанной теме («Кстати о...»).

prompt: Let's (say / talk) the schedule over before we send it to the whole team.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk something over означает «подробно обсудить что-либо».
